rationale: The fixed split is signer-disjoint and reserves complete vowel coverage for validation and test. S2 contributes indoor unprepared bright/dark samples; S3 contributes prepared and real-world unprepared samples, which permits a descriptive condition analysis without selecting the split from model results.
v2_warning: This split puts S5 and S14 in train. Version 2 must use scripts/build_v2_samples.py after configs/v2_protocol.json is frozen.
